name: ticker-universe-builder
description: Build evidence-gated native, Global and Global Core universes with validated TradingView exports.

interface.longDescription: Compose one Global universe without depth profiles from qualified native-market universes and verified references, derive a reviewed Global Core with complete or explicitly focused operating coverage, or build and maintain fourteen native markets at four depths. Research issuer identities, ETF quality, economic coverage and dated measurements. Python validates contracts and writes portable JSON, TradingView TXT, Markdown and HTML. Global validation checks independent coverage duties, exact source hashes, issuer duplicates and ETF evidence. Pilot scope and source cutoffs remain explicit. Standard library, Python 3.10+, no service or required API key. No return guarantees, allocations or trade execution.
defaultPrompt: Build a US Medium ticker universe using current online evidence, with HTML, Markdown and TradingView exports.
Maintain my existing ticker universe and explain additions, removals and unresolved research.
Expand my qualified Heavy universe to Max with sourced Beta while preserving its theme distribution.
Compose a researched Global universe with issuer deduplication, ETF quality and TradingView TXT exports.
Build a focused Global Core with primary leaders, audited full-only depth, protected coverage and ETF quality gates.

publication.release_notes: 0.13.0: consolidated single-mode Global workflow, reviewed Core companion and reproducible sectioned Global examples in the unified offline rebuild.

zh-CN.subtitle: 构建可核验的标的观察池
zh-CN.description: 构建和维护有证据支持的观察池：十四个原生市场使用 Light、Medium、Heavy、Max 四个档位；Global 使用单一构建模式，可派生经过审核的 Core 子集。Agent 研究龙头、ETF 质量与覆盖，Python 验证证据并生成带分组的 TradingView TXT、Markdown、HTML、JSON 和验证报告。示例可离线复现，最新研究需要网络及有日期的数据。Python 3.10+，标准库，无必需 API 密钥。不提供收益承诺、仓位配置或交易执行。
